chunks: And those of the left hand -- how (unhappy) will be those of the left hand!

key_terms.الْمَشْأَمَةِ: The left hand (specifically referring to receiving the book of deeds)
key_terms.مَا: Exclamatory particle indicating wretchedness or misfortune

ai.seo_question: Who are the Ashab al-Mash'amah and what does their left-hand reception signify?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this exclamatory verse underscores the definitive separation of the 'Ashab al-Mash'amah' from divine mercy, often linked to their rejection of the Ahl al-Bayt and the Imams. The left hand signifies the receipt of the book of deeds with disgrace, marking them as those who turned away from the truth and the guidance of the Prophet's progeny. This serves as a solemn warning to believers to align their actions with the path of the Twelve Imams to avoid this wretched fate.
